description: This file extends account journal and account move line models in Odoo to add date validation logic for accounting entries, including a new boolean field 'allow_date' and a method 'check_date' to enforce date within period constraints.

classes.name: account_journal
classes.description: Extends the account.journal model to include 'allow_date' boolean field with default True.

classes.name: account_move_line
classes.description: Extends the account.move.line model with date validation logic in 'check_date' method, and overrides 'write' and 'create' methods to enforce date checks.

methods.name: check_date
methods.description: Validates that the move date is within the period unless 'allow_date' is set to True.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides the write method to include date validation before updating records.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Overrides the create method to include date validation before creating records.
